title: Use more than one image in the pattern.
description: Combine image layers instead of relying on a single tile. This example uses Stack Bands to place two source images in horizontal bands before generating the stereogram.
credit: Original Blender scene and patterns by Blue Nile. Generated with Magic Eye Maker 4.0.

states.caption: The second source image supplies the graphic dashes.
